I'm Felix, a final-year Ph.D. student in Sociology at the Ecole Polytechnique in Paris, currently living in Boston with my partner and two cats. I'm a German citizen with a valid U.S. work permit.

I hold a Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science (University of Regensburg), a Master of Science in Computational Social Science from Linköping University, and will defend my Ph.D. in Sociology at the Ecole Polytechnique in Paris on March 4, 2026. During my Ph.D., I also spent two Spring terms as a visiting scholar at Duke University.

You can find my CV below. For collaboration or opportunities, reach out via [email](mailto:felix.lennert@icloud.com) or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/felix-lennert/).

## Summary

Early-career Data Scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning, NLP, causal inference, and statistical modeling to real-world, data-heavy problems. Experienced in owning end-to-end analysis, working with ambiguous datasets, and translating business and product questions into reproducible, actionable insights across Python, SQL, and R. 

## Technical Skills

- **Languages & Tools:** Python (pandas, scikit-learn, transformers, numpy, langchain), SQL, R (tidyverse, ggplot2, RShiny), MS Excel
- **Machine Learning & Analytics:** NLP, text classification, SpaCy, clustering, forecasting, A/B testing, regression
- **Causal Inference:** Difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity score matching
- **Data Practices:** Agentic workflows (cursor), dashboarding (RShiny, PowerBI, Looker, Tableau), version control (git), web scraping
